description: git_serious CI record (req-boot-bootstrap-ci-record, tap#365) — the stack this plugin's own tests run in, and the one claim per-plugin CI is allowed to make: that git_serious is correct against the dependencies it DECLARES and nothing else. Install set is exactly the depends_on closure (identity_core, git_core, compliance_core, administrivia, github_core) plus git_serious itself; the consumer flips the self entry to editable so the CHECKOUT under test runs, not the pinned revision. Population seeds administrivia, git_serious (seed-only, offline). DELIBERATELY EXCLUDED: every other plugin, all credentials, all required_secrets, and any population step that reaches the network — so a fork can run this lane and a nightly cannot flake on a third party (req-boot-bootstrap-ci-record-5). Reproduce CI exactly: spawn --from 'git+https://github.com/unified-systems-com/git-serious-tap@8e390633f5db3ccd2f17a646813a3285cc30cf5a#ci' --dev-plugins git_serious

steps.note: administrivia's GRIFT, which this plugin's pages reference or link to.
Own GRIFT: seeding it proves the bundle parses and its panel types resolve against a real registry.

fips_waivers.reason: Carried from zizmor-tap's own ci record: zizmor is a static YAML linter for GitHub Actions workflows; the shipped Rust binary links boringssl and aws-lc-rs for its HTTPS client (fetching remote workflow references), which TAP never invokes in the operational request path — the plugin runs zizmor on local files only. No TAP data is encrypted, signed or hashed by these providers. Waived for the plugin's own test stack (zizmor-tap#10 owns the product decision: declare in [fips] or build against system OpenSSL). git_serious installs zizmor in its CI stack only because the strict validator requires the depends_on closure to be installed (optional dependency, guarded import); the product record does not install it.
